OpenTelemetry.description: Configures the OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs of the application. Read when calling 'AddOpenTelemetry()' on the Orchard Core builder, e.g. 'services.AddOrchardCms().AddOpenTelemetry()'. The standard 'OTEL_*' configuration values are also supported. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/OpenTelemetry/.

ServiceName.description: The 'service.name' resource attribute. Defaults to the application name. The 'OTEL_SERVICE_NAME' configuration value takes precedence.

ServiceInstanceId.description: The 'service.instance.id' resource attribute identifying this instance of the application, e.g. in a web farm. Defaults to the machine name followed by the process id.

SamplingRatio.description: The ratio, from 0 to 1, of the traces that are sampled. A trace started by a sampled parent is always sampled. When not set, all traces are sampled.

Sources.description: The names of additional activity sources to collect traces from.

IncludeDatabaseQueryText.description: Whether the spans of the database operations include their SQL text, in 'db.query.text'. The commands run by YesSql are parameterized, so their text holds no values.

SlowShapeThreshold.description: The duration from which the rendering of a shape is traced with its own span, e.g. '00:00:00.050' for 50 milliseconds. '00:00:00' traces every shape.

IncludeTenantName.description: Whether the HTTP server metrics are tagged with the name of the tenant that served the request. Disable it to limit the number of metric series with many tenants.

Meters.description: The names of additional meters to collect metrics from.

Otlp.description: Configures the OTLP exporter. When neither 'Endpoint' nor the 'OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT' configuration value is set, the telemetry is not exported over OTLP.

Endpoint.description: The endpoint of the OTLP receiver, e.g. 'http://localhost:4317' for gRPC or 'http://localhost:4318' for HTTP.

Protocol.description: The protocol used to export to the endpoint.
